{{Top}}
'''Housekeeping droids''', also known as '''housecleaning droids''' or '''Housekeeping Specialist Droids''', or '''domestic droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed to perform housekeeping duties. Unlike most [[cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning droids]], which were [[Class five droid/Legends|class five droids]], housekeeping droids were considered [[Class three droid/Legends|class three]] due to their interaction with living beings.
